executedChecks.scope: Focused offline run: record-codec and CLI tests (real filesystem, real journal and import calls through the registered `harness` command). Manual mutation checks (each failed tests before restoring): O_NOFOLLOW removed from input reads, canonical-bytes check removed from decode, trusted-hash comparison removed from validate, recovery action forced to none, decision/chosen consistency check removed, mixed-kind comparison allowed, binding-not-applicable check removed. Review-found defect fixed before merge: a journal terminal state `unobserved` was refused by the attempt-status codec (test added). Second review round: non-string/unhashable `format` values (list, dict, number, null) now refuse with unknown-format through decode and the CLI instead of raising TypeError; input reads loop until EOF or the limit so a short read cannot truncate (tests with a chunking os.read); compare now carries unlistedChange=true when records differ only outside the compared subset; usage-error vs refusal exit-2 convention (matches forecast_cli) documented and pinned; shared TERMINALS constant reused. Mutations killed: read loop, format type check, unlistedChange.

outcome: Six entry points (inspect, validate, prepare, status, recover-inspect, compare) under one `harness` subparser; exit 0 ok, 2 refusal with a single JSON object carrying a fixed reason code and executionAuthorization false; unexpected internal errors are not converted into refusals. Four versioned strict codecs (manifest, decision, attempt-status, comparison) accept only exact canonical bytes, so records round-trip byte for byte; unknown formats, future versions, extra/missing fields, non-canonical spellings, oversized input and authority-granting flags refuse. inspect shows base/candidate file diff, evidence losses and profile limits without effects; prepare is the only effect (one new private candidate directory via the existing importer); status/recover-inspect read the journal without writing and point at reconciliation without performing it. A test proves the top-level help differs from the pre-change help only by the harness entry.
limits: Offline, single-host library calls. validate without --sha256 proves shape only (reported as authenticity=unverified); a hash match proves byte identity, not source rights or containment. The CLI performs no admission, reservation, dispatch or reconciliation: those stay with the separately reviewed operator contract (not part of this task). Observation and proposal records have no CLI codec yet (only manifest, decision, attempt-status, comparison). Input file reads are bounded and refuse symlinks/specials but are not protected against a hostile same-UID actor swapping files. --now defaults to the system clock when omitted; trusted-clock supply is the operator's job. No host, model, provider, native containment or utility claim.
